items.title: Consent calendar (sample)
items.summary: Routine approvals voted together. Any item can be pulled for discussion.

items.title: Park fee schedule update (sample)
items.summary: Updates recreation fees for county parks after a public hearing.

items.title: Fifth Street bike lane corridor (sample)
items.summary: Staff recommends a protected lane with one parking change. Comment is accepted before the vote.
items.what_it_decides: Whether Fifth Street gets a protected bike lane and which parking spaces change.
items.who_it_affects: Residents and businesses on Fifth Street.

items.title: Groundwater monitoring contract (sample)
items.summary: Approves a three-year monitoring contract. Scope and cost are in the attachment.

items.title: Short-term rental rules (sample)
items.summary: Updates permit rules for short-term rentals citywide. Continued to a later date.

items.title: Library hours update (sample)
items.summary: Staff asks for direction on weekend hours. No final vote today.

items.title: Street repair budget amendment (sample)
items.summary: Moves funds to repair arterial streets. Needs a simple majority.
items.what_it_decides: Which arterial streets are repaired first, and with which money.
items.who_it_affects: Drivers and bus riders on arterial streets.

items.title: Noise ordinance update (sample)
items.summary: Changes nighttime noise limits. A second reading comes later.

items.title: Quarterly budget report (sample)
items.summary: Reports spending through the first quarter. No vote.

items.title: Attendance boundary review (sample)
items.summary: Staff presents boundary options for two schools.

items.title: Facilities bond project list (sample)
items.summary: Approves the list of projects a bond would fund. Voter approval is separate.
items.what_it_decides: Which school projects a future bond would pay for. Voters decide on the bond itself.
items.who_it_affects: Families and staff at the schools on the list.

items.title: Superintendent search update (sample)
items.summary: Update on the recruiting timeline. Closed session may follow.
